item.description:
# Séance 0.3.61
- Location links open folders and ignore legacy run parameters. Command automation continues through the local CLI. - Bundled GhosttyKit, resources and zmx downloads use pinned versions and SHA-256 checks, including cached files. Dependency versions are unchanged. - Devices need input permission to create chats with messages or attachments, resume chats, or continue them on another account. Empty chats still need only create permission. - Handled Open Questions replies leave the attention list once their delivery is resolved.
